math: Assumption: ~$80 per order (change it when we know the real price). 300 orders ≈ $24k revenue.
Our bar is $2k per 1M views; robe sellers claim $3–6k. So 300 orders need about 5–12M views in the week ≈ 0.7–1.7M views a day.

Robe virals in our data: 146.7M (plain, 'cold-aholics'), 26M (princess, drop-open), 8.5M (Grinch-style, drop-open), 5.3M, 2.99M. One video at 3M+ covers half the week — so volume of tries matters more than perfection.
With 15 videos a day for 7 days (105 videos) we need an average of ~50–120k views per video, or 1–2 breakouts.
daily: 15 videos a day, mixed (HeatGrump rule): 5 proven hooks, 5 adapted from the newest robe virals, 5 new tests. Never 5 of the same kind in a row.
Post on 8–10 accounts (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok), 2 posts per account per day, 3+ hours apart. Every video also goes out once as a trial reel.
Production: 3 new person+room sets a day (put on · open · cozy, each set reused in 5 videos) + 15 hooks + the fixed controller and connector clips. ≈ 3×143 + 15×44 ≈ 1,100 credits a day (~$45–65).
Test every new hook at 480p first, 1080p only if it looks right.
Every evening: read the 24 h numbers; next day make 3 more videos of the best hook and drop the worst 5.

convert: Comment-to-DM: 'Comment GRUMP and I'll send you the link' on every post (the top robe sellers all do this).
Landing page: 1 robe / 2-pack (best value) / 3-pack, gift message, 'arrives before Christmas' date, no power bank needed or included — state it clearly.
Link in bio on every account; pin the best video.
Reply videos to real comments ('does it really get warm?') — they get pushed to new people.

plan.do: Top up credits. Make 3 sets + 15 hooks (480p tests, then 1080p). Check landing page and checkout. Post the first 10–15.
Post 15. First 24 h numbers: keep hooks above the account median, drop the rest.
Make 3 versions of the best hook with new people and rooms. Add 2 new identity texts.
Repost the top 3 videos as trial reels. Start 2 new accounts if any account is held back.
Double the winning hook (6–8 of today's 15). Count orders vs views: $ per 1M views.
Push winners to every account. If $/1M ≥ $3k, add a 4th set a day.
Final push with the 5 best videos + the 'arrives before Christmas' angle. Write down what worked as rules.

kpis: Views per video in 24 h (target 50k+ average)
risks: IP: never write 'Grinch' in captions, texts or the store — it is a trademark. Say 'grumpy green', 'HeatGrump', 'Christmas grump'.
No real store names (Costco, IKEA, H&M) and no Disney/licensed looks in our videos.
Shipping time before Christmas: promise only what the supplier can deliver.
New accounts can be held back the first days: warm them up, never post the exact same file twice on one account.
